initialExam.title: Indian Army TES 2026 (Technical Entry Scheme)
initialExam.description: Technical Entry Scheme for 10+2 pass candidates to join the Indian Army as officers in the technical branch. Candidates undergo engineering degree training at CME Pune and other institutions.
initialExam.eligibility: 12th pass with PCM (Physics, Chemistry, Math) with 70% aggregate
initialExam.qualifications: 10+2 with minimum 70% in PCM from recognized board
initialExam.syllabus: No written exam. SSB Interview: Intelligence Test, Group Testing, Psychology Tests, Personal Interview.
initialExam.examPattern: Shortlisting based on JEE Mains score. SSB Interview: 5 days.
initialExam.selectionProcess: JEE Mains Score → Shortlisting → SSB Interview (5 days) → Medical → Merit
initialExam.careerGrowth: Lieutenant → Captain → Major → Lieutenant Colonel → Colonel → Brigadier → Major General.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit joinindianarmy.nic.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. JEE Mains shortlisting 5. SSB Interview
initialExam.perks: MSP: ₹15,500, DA, Kit allowance, Free accommodation, Medical, CSD, Leave Travel
